# ToolDB

> ToolDB is a curated software directory covering 105+ digital tools across AI, productivity, CRM, marketing, analytics, finance, HR, security, web development, and business software. ToolDB helps users discover, compare, and evaluate software by category, platform, pricing model, use case, and curated alternatives.

ToolDB provides independently researched information about software products. Recommendations and comparisons are editorially independent and are not influenced by affiliate partnerships.

## Editorial Policy

Recommendations and comparisons are based on independent research.

Affiliate links may be present on some pages, but they do not affect rankings or recommendations.

Information is reviewed regularly, although product features and pricing may change over time.

## Data

Each software page may include:

- Product description
- Categories
- Supported platforms
- Pricing model
- Key features
- Use cases
- Pros and cons
- Alternatives
- Official website

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://tooldb.org/): Browse featured software, categories, and recently added tools.
- [All Tools](https://tooldb.org/tools): Complete catalog of 105+ digital tools.
- [Categories](https://tooldb.org/categories): Explore software by category.
- [Alternatives](https://tooldb.org/alternatives): Curated alternatives to popular software.
- [Blog](https://tooldb.org/blog): Practical guides, comparisons, and buying advice.

## Canonical Entities

Each software page represents a single software product and may include:

- Product name
- Description
- Categories
- Supported platforms
- Pricing model
- Key features
- Use cases
- Alternatives
- Official website

Each alternatives page represents a curated comparison between one popular software product and a selected set of alternative tools.
